segments.text: Randy Orton/Sheamus/Big Show/Antonio Cesaro/Booker T Interview
Booker T/Big Show/Alberto Del Rio Interview
The Rock/Cody Rhodes/Damien Sandow Interview- The Rock has finally come back to …. Smackdown.
Alberto Del Rio/Dolff Ziggler/Big Show/Sheamus/Booker T Interview- Del Rio has his fiesta celebration after the main event is set for tonight. Man o man has wrestling fallen since the attitude era.
Daniel Bryan/Kane/Big Show/Cody Rhodes/Damien Sandow/Alberto Del Rio/Booker T Interview
CM Punk/The Rock Interview- Punk continues to deny that he has anything to do with The Shield.
Alberto Del Rio/Randy Orton/Booker T Interview
Jim Ross/Jack Swagger/Zeb Colter/Alberto Del Rio Interview
Fandango Int- Fandango cuts a backstage promo and says he will make his debut when Matt Striker gets his name right. Not sure what to think of him yet. Wait and see.
Booker T and Damien Sandow backstage segment. Zack Ryder, Dolph Ziggler, Big E. Langston, AJ Lee, Natalya, R-Truth and Daniel Bryan interrupt.
Cody Rhodes/Damien Sandow Int, Fandango Promo
Teddy Long, Natalya and AJ Lee backstage segment.
Alberto Del Rio/Ricardo Rodriguez Segment- They mock Colter and Swagger again.
Great Khali/Fandango Interview/Segment- Once again, Fandango delays his debut.
Brodus Clay, Tensai and Mick Foley backstage segment. Rosa Mendes, Epico and Primo interrupt.
Brodus Clay, Tensai, Mick Foley and the Prime Time Players (Darren Young & Titus O’Neil) backstage segment.
Chris Jericho Interview- Fandango comes out but does nothing.
Damien Sandow/Cody Rhodes/Bella Twins Segment- They mock the Funk group until the real group comes out to brawl with them.
Mick Foley and Team Rhodes Scholars (Cody Rhodes & Damien Sandow) backstage segment.
Dolff Ziggler/Jack Swagger/Alberto Del Rio/Chris Jericho Interview- Ziggler's first promo after winning his World Heavyweight Title from Raw.
Mick Foley, Mark Henry and Daniel Bryan backstage segment.

Fandango/Santino Marella Interview- Fandango asks Lillian Garcia if she has ever "Fandango-ed" before, which was a little creepy to watch. After her spins her, he drops her saying that she was terrible. Santino comes out and does what he does, saying funny things in a funny way. WWE needs more Santino. That's somebody who should have a talk show on Raw.
Mick Foley, Kofi Kingston and Justin Gabriel backstage segment.
Team Rhodes Scholars (Cody Rhodes & Damien Sandow), the Brooklyn Brawler, the Usos (Jey Uso & Jimmy Uso) and Mick Foley backstage segment.
The Shield Int, Daniel Bryan Segment
Mick Foley, the Usos (Jey Uso & Jimmy Uso) and the Prime Time Players (Darren Young & Titus O'Neil) backstage segment.
Mark Henry Segment- Henry pushes a couple of tractor trucks.
Mick Foley and Santino Marella backstage segment. Jinder Mahal interrupts.
John Cena/Mark Henry Segment from Raw
Alberto Del Rio/Dolff Ziggler Segment- Ziggler attacks Del Rio, dressed up as Sin Cara.
Teddy Long/Booker T/Vince McMahon/Brad Maddox/Vickie Guerrero Interview
CM Punk Interview- Fandango comes out but gets GTS'd by Punk.
Damien Sandow/Cody Rhodes Interview/Segment- Sandow wants his briefcase back but Cody tosses it into the Gulf of Mexico.
Los Matadores Promo, Daniel Bryan/Vickie Guerrero/Ryback Int
Triple H/Rob Van Dam Interview- Triple H has everybody stand on the ramp while he addresses what has been going on. A few mid-carders speak up like Kofi Kingston, Heath Slater, and Damien Sandow.
Triple H/Big Show Interview- Eventually, The Shield come out to attack Big Show.
Ryback Segment, Vickie Guerrero/Ricardo Rodriguez Int
Nattie and TJ’s wedding takes an unexpected turn. John asks Nikki to meet his family. Ariane is rushed to the hospital. Eva and JoJo’s friendship starts to fall apart.
Triple H/Rob Van Dam/Alberto Del Rio Backstage Segment
Vickie Guerrero/Triple H Int, Primetime Players Backstage Segment
Vickie Guerrero/Alberto Del Rio/Damien Sandow Interview
Big Show Interview- Show knocks out Brad Maddox.
John Cena/Zeb Colter/Damien Sandow/Vickie Guerrero Interview
Alberto Del Rio/John Cena/Vickie Guerrero Interview
Vickie Guerrero/Great Khali/Titus O'Neil Backstage Segment
John Cena/Kane Interview- The Shield, Mark Henry, and Big E Langston all get involved in a quick brawl.
John Cena/Dolff Ziggler/AJ/Big E Langston Interview

CM Punk/The Rock Interview- Punk went on and on a little too long about how he has the crowd until The Rock came out to shut him up (which was probably the point). There was certainly some good moments in the interview between The Rock but it's too bad that there are only 2 more Raws to go until their match at the Royal Rumble. Maybe they will have some confrontions on Smackdown.
Vince McMahon/Big Show/Alberto Del Rio Interview
Kane/Daniel Bryan/Dr. Shelby/Damien Sandow/Cody Rhodes Segment
Mick Foley/The Shield/Ryback/Randy Orton/Sheamus Segment- Foley is the first one announced for the 2013 Hall of Fame before it leads to a brawl.
Vickie Guerrero/Paul Heyman/The Rock Interview- Vickie has banned The Rock from coming into the building.
Mick Foley Video, The Shield Segment
The Rock/Vickie Guerrero Interview- The Rock is still trying to get into the ring.
Dr. Shelby/Daniel Bryan/Kane Segment- Team Hell No graduate from Anger Management.
Paul Heyman/The Rock/CM Punk Interview- CM Punk watches the interview from the Skybox section as The Shield would attack The Rock.
John Cena Interview- Ends in a brawl to promote the Royal Rumble.
John Cena Interview- After Cena says that he is going after the WWE Championship, it would lead to a brawl with Cena, Sheamus, and Ryback.
Alberto Del Rio/Big Show/Ricardo Rodriguez Segment- Big Show gets some payback after what happened last night.
Great Khali/3MB Segment- It's stupid segments like these that beg for Raw to go back to 2 hours.
Chris Jericho/Dolff Ziggler/Vickie Guerrero Interview- Jericho returned last night, Ziggler comes out to confront him, Big E Langston still looks like a goober, and AJ is still a 'spinner'.

Vince McMahon/Paul Heyman Interview- Just when it looked like Vince was going to fire Heyman, who was brilliant in this segment by the way, Brock Lesnar returns (again) to F-5 Vince. I love it. How is it going to work with CM Punk and Brock Lesnar having Paul Heyman as their manager? Now with the video playing of Heyman talking to The Shield, how does the Shield play into this? This is the kind of stuff I love watching wrestling for. Don't mess it up, E.
Miz TV with Paul Heyman/Vickie Guerrero/Brock Lesnar- Lesnar comes out to beat up Miz.
Fandango Promo- The dude is dancing and then says his name.

Brad Maddox/The Shield Interview- Turns into a brawl when John Cena, Sheamus, and Ryback come down to get a piece of The Shield. I love the fact that the WWE didn't punk The Shield members here by getting their ass beat. It was just a 30 second brawl and then the Shield left going back through the crowd. Nice. So far, so good with the use and storylines of the Shield. I just feel eventually the WWE is going to job them out sooner or later and then there is nothing left of this nice build-up.
Paul Heyman/CM Punk Interview- Heyman says this is the last time we are going to see him. Well that sucks. He's been great for Punk and Lesnar.
The Shield Interview- Leads to a brawl with John Cena, Sheamus, and Ryback.
The Rock Interview- CM Punk with Paul Heyman comes out to brawl with The Rock.
Vickie Guerrero/Paul Heyman/Vince McMahon Interview- Vince wants to fight Heyman next week instead of firing him.
Kofi Kingston/Damien Sandow/R-Truth Brawl- R-Truth returns.

The Rock Interview- The Rock gets rid of the spinning WWE title belt (finally) but unveils a belt that's only so-so. Just a big WWE logo on the front with the word "Champion". I miss those winged eagle belts. Anyways, John Cena starts walking towards the Rock when CM Punk nails Cena from behind with the spinning belt.
Vince McMahon/Paul Heyman Interview- After a few words are exchange, they start to brawl until Brock Lesnar shows up, followed shortly by the return of Triple H who goes after Lesnar.
The Shield/Sheamus Interview- Sheamus distracts The Shield long enough for Randy Orton to come from behind and RKO Seth Rollings.
Undertaker Segment- Quick appearance by the Undertaker before the show starts.
CM Punk/Randy Orton/Big Show/Sheamus/Vickie Guerrero Interview

The Rock/John Cena Interview- Point, counter-point type of interview as they say. "Winning is about heart. You just have to have it in the right place. The man who said that quote, Lance Armstrong. He was full of crap and so are you." - Rock.
Fandango Interview- Fandango stalls his debut once again.
Triple H Interview- Hunter wants Brock at Wrestlemania.
Undertaker/CM Punk Interview- "In 4 weeks, you're gonna be 20 and 1"- Punk.

Highlight Reel with The Miz/Wade Barrett/Brad Maddox- "The only reason you keep bringing up your movie is to distract from the fact that you haven't won a match in weeks"- Miz. This show is full of quotes. Brad Maddox came in to make this segment very awkward. Either he was very bad on the mic on purpose or he really didn't know what his lines were.
Alberto Del Rio/Ricardo Rodriguez Segment- They replay the video from Smackdown.
Holly Berry/David Otunga/Kane Segment- The WWE is pimping out way too many movies.
Fandango/Great Khali/Natalya Segment- Once again, we almost see the debut of Fandango.
Undertaker/CM Punk Interview- Punk drops Paul Bearer's Urn, but "no disrespect".

Triple H/Paul Heyman/Brock Lesnar Interview- At Wrestlemania, the Triple H/Brock Lesnar match is No DQ and Triple H's career is on the line. At this point, does it matter if Triple H's career is on the line? He wrestles like 3 times a year.
CM Punk Interview- Undertaker gets in a few punches before Punk runs away.
John Cena/The Rock Interview- On the panel asking questions was the following WWE Hall of Famers… Bret Hart, Dusty Rhodes, Mick Foley, and Booker T.
John Cena Interview- Crowd chants boring at Cena. Jerry Lawler says that he picks The Rock to win at Wrestlemania which is the kiss of death. That means Cena will win.
Shawn Michaels/Triple H/Paul Heyman/Brock Lesnar Interview

The Rock Interview- I think at this point in time.. I'm kinda over The Rock right now. I hate to say it but some time away would freshin up his character a bit. You know when he comes out pretty much what he is going to say. Last year, his promos were a lot more unpredictable and fun. This year, not so much.
Undertaker/CM Punk/Paul Heyman Segment- Punk pours out the ashes of "Paul Bearer" all over Undertaker and himself.
John Cena/Mark Henry/Booker T Interview- Crowd is booing Cena (mostly) as there is certainly a Wrestlemania hangover in the crowd tonight.
Undertaker/The Shield/Kane/Daniel Bryan Segment- The Shield was going to go after Undertaker alone until Kane and Bryan make the save.
3MB Interview- Brock Lesnar comes out to beat up on 3MB after they were calling out The Shield.
Paul Heyman/Brock Lesnar Interview- Heyman and Lesnar want Triple H at Extreme Rules in a Steel Cage match.
Dolff Ziggler/Alberto Del Rio Interview- Turns into an Alberto Del Rio/Jack Swagger brawl.
CM Punk Interview- Shortly into this, Punk just walks out of the ring and to the back. Looks like Punk is going to get his time off to heal up.
John Cena Interview- Cena wants to know whats up with Ryback but Ryback walks off but watches when The Shield comes out to lay Cena out.
Mick Foley/Ryback Interview- John Cena saves Ryback from a Shield beatdown, only to hit him with the AA after.
The Shield/3MB Interview- Daniel Bryan and Kane come out to brawl with 3MB after The Shield take off.
Great Khali/Fandango Segment- They have a dance off segment, I guess, I don't know. I'm not really paying attention anymore at this point. 3 hours is just too damn long.

John Cena/Vickie Guerrero/Ryback Interview- The WWE gives Ryback a chance to cut a real live, in-ring promo. Ryback announces that their match at Extreme Rules match will be a Last Man Standing match.

Triple H/Paul Heyman Interview- "Do you ever open your mouth without a bunch of crap coming out of it?"- Triple H says Paul Heyman's 'hair' looks like the head of a baby chick. Ha! That was funny. Triple H mentions that he knows something about being extreme and that he ran through the attitude era with an iron fist. Triple H really does seem like he is the last of the attitude era and certainly brings something different to the table when he is on Raw.
Ryback Interview- Ryback conducts the interview on top of an ambulance.

Paul Heyman/Curtis Axel/Triple H Interview- Heyman introduces his newest "Paul Heyman Guy", Curtis Axel, formerly known as Michael McGillicutty. He uses a remix song of his father's entrance music (Mr. Perfect). Triple H slaps Curtis and then says he will face him tonight.
Wyatt Family First Promo- Not sure who these guys but then again I'm not a NXT follower. I think one of those guys is Husky Harris?
Stephanie/Vince McMahon Interview- Neither of them want Triple H to be in a match tonight due to his injuries. Crowd doesn't like that.
Contract Signing with Chris Jericho/Paul Heyman- Earlier in the show, they were promoting this segment but they had CM Punk's picture. A little misleading if you were hoping to see Punk.
Daniel Bryan/Kane Int, Wyatt Family Promo
Triple H/Curtis Axel/Vince McMahon Segment- Triple H wants to battle it out with Curtis Axel but Vince comes down 3 different times to stop the match.
Chris Jericho/Dolff Ziggler Interview- Ziggler finally returns to Raw.

Alberto Del Rio/CM Punk/Paul Heyman/Vickie Guerrero Interview- Punk returns to Raw and Alberto Del Rio is heel again. Let me say it again. Punk is back on Raw!! All is right with the world as CM Punk has the Hugh Jackman/Wolverine beard going on.
Rob Van Dam Promo- RVD is coming back at the next ppv!
John Cena/Mark Henry Interview- Mark Henry delivers an emotion retirement speech but then bodyslams Cena, signalling that he isn't done yet.
CM Punk/Paul Heyman Interview- Heyman said he had nothing to do with Lesnar attacking him.
Stephanie Segment, Vickie Guerrero/Brad Maddox/Ryback/Chris Jericho Int, CM Punk/Paul Heyman Int
Wyatt Family Promo- They debut next week.
Damien Sandow/Cody Rhodes/Zeb Colter/Wade Barrett/Fandango Int/Segment

Mark Henry/Shield Segment- Mark Henry gets attacked by the Shield as it looks like the E wants to turn Mark Henry face. Henry hasn't been a face in about a decade and the E probably got the idea when Henry teased his retirement and the crowd was backing him big time.

CM Punk/Paul Heyman Interview- Great segment here. Heyman and Punk have an intense interview about why Heyman turned on Punk until Brock Lesnar comes out to attack Punk. They did a great job of making it look like Punk might have a chance against Lesnar during the brawl (after his tough match last night) but Lesnar kept getting the better of Punk until he finally hit the F-5 on Punk onto the announcer's table. This is a segment that will make a lot of viewers think about ordering Summerslam, including myself.
John Cena/Daniel Bryan Interview/Segment- Cena chooses Bryan as his opponent for Summerslam.

Miz TV with Divas- Brie Bella has a nip slip! I didn't think I would be getting it since I am on the west coast and there would be plenty of time for them to edit it but they didn't! Her nipple pops out and shows near the end of the segment after Miz announces the Total Divas show and all the girls are clapping. Yay for boobies!
Wyatt Family Promo, Kane/Brad Maddox Int

Stephanie McMahon/Daniel Bryan/Vince McMahon Interview- Bryan says his is going to win at Summerslam because Cena is an 'entertainer' and Daniel Bryan is a 'wrestler'. It's sad when people like Punk and Bryan can say 'wrestler' to help get a reaction. The term 'wrestler' should be used all the time because that's what these guys are. When somebody asks them what they do for a living and they reply with 'Sports Entertainer', people will have no idea what they are talking about. Just saying 'wrestler' sums it up much more quickly.
Vince McMahon/Brad Maddox/Triple H Interview- Hunter announces that he will be the referee for the Cena/Bryan match at Summerslam, then pedigrees Maddox.

Miz TV with John Cena/Daniel Bryan- Great interview. I'm not sure if it was just because I was there but there was some good intense stuff being said here. I do agree that it's getting lame that Cena's opponent's use the same stuff against him (can't wrestle, jean shorts, etc) but then again, it's also how a good portion of the crowd feels. Bryan says that in Japan, he learned a trade where before a match, the wrestlers would slap their opponent as hard as they could to bring out the best in one another but since Bryan doesn't think of Cena as a wrestler, that Cena doesn't deserve the slap.

20 Man Battle Royal- Won by Rob Van Dam who last threw out Mark Henry. After the match, The Shield come down like they are going to attack but Mark Henry and the returning Big Show make them change their mind.
Alberto Del Rio/Ricardo Rodriquez/Rob Van Dam Segment Interview- The former announcer for Del Rio is now with Rob Van Dam.
Los Matadores Promo, Christian/Randy Orton Int
CM Punk/Brad Maddox Int, Los Matadores Promo

Triple H/Randy Orton/Daniel Bryan Interview- "I can bring back the Cruiserweight title, or the European title. He (Daniel Bryan) can go after any one of those titles. That's a good little goal for him"- Triple H (Paraphrasing). That's pretty funny.
Los Matadores Promo- These are really bad promos. Do these promos make anybody want to see their debut?
Edge/Daniel Bryan/Randy Orton/Triple H Interview- Amazing ovation for Edge as he and Triple H exchange some mean verbage.
Daniel Bryan/Triple H/Randy Orton Interview- Triple H strips Daniel Bryan of the WWE Title due to him saying that he was in on the fast count from last night.
Stephanie McMahon/Dusty Rhodes/Triple H/Big Show Interview/Segment- The power trippers force Big Show to knock out Dusty Rhodes. The Stephanie/Dusty confrontation was fun.
Los Matadores Promo- When Fandango had his promos earlier this year, you wanted to see him by the time he debuted. Doesn't anybody feel the need to see these guys?
Triple H/Stephanie McMahon/Rob van Dam Interview- It sounds like Hunter is trying to turn all the guys who stood up for Daniel Bryan last week against him.
Rob Van Dam/Alberto Del Rio Segment
Los Matadores Promo, Randy Orton/Bella Twins Int, Stephanie/AJ Int
CM Punk/Paul Heyman Interview- Leads to a brawl with Punk fighting off Ryback and Curtis Axel until Ryback slams Punk through a table. Huga ovation for Punk in his hometown.
The Shield/Cody Rhodes/Goldust Segment- The Rhodes Brothers, coming from the crowd, attack The Shield members for a brief moment before security takes them to the back.
CM Punk/Brad Maddox/Big E Langston Interview
Paul Heyman Int, Los Matadores Promo

Triple H/Stephanie/Dusty/Cody Rhodes/Goldust Interview- The Shield attack the Rhodes Family after Triple H and Stephanie give them a chance to get their jobs back if they can beat the Shield at the ppv.

Peul Heyman/Ryback Interview- Heyman says that 2013 has been such a progressive year and then proposes to Ryback on one knee and then asks him, "Will you be a Paul Heyman Guy"? Before Ryback answers, CM Punk comes out from the crowd but then suckers Paul Heyman in by faking a knee injury. Punk uses a Kendo stick to hit the Heyman crew a few times and then finishes Curtis Axel off with the GTS.
Randy Orton/Daniel Bryan Interview- Orton starts making it personal when he brings up Brie Bella and this leads to a brawl to close the show.
Stephanie McMahon/Big Show Interview- Stephanie fires the Big Show.
Shawn Michaels Segment- Michaels gets voted in to be the referee of the main event at Hell in a Cell.
Shawn Michaels/Randy Orton Interview- We are still waiting on the Triple H/Shawn Micheals confrontation.
John Cena/Damien Sandow Interview- After Sandow attacked Cena's injured elbow, he calls out a referee to cash in his MITB title shot.
Shawn Michaels/Daniel Bryan Interview- Michaels says that he and Triple H are best friends and that's why he superkicked Daniel Bryan last night. Bryan then puts Michaels in the Yes-lock.
Primetime Players Segment- What's this? Primetime players showing some charisma?
Triple H/Big Show Segment, Triple H/Stephanie Int

Big Show/Triple H/Stephanie McMahon/ Interview- After Show gets his job back and a title match against Randy Orton at Survivor Series, The Shield and Orton destroy the Big Show. Even Kane comes out, dressed up in a suit, and lends a non-violent hand. I'm really intrigued to see what they are going to do with Kane.
Kane/Brad Maddox Int, Zack Ryder WWF Shop Segment
Paul Heyman Interview- CM Punk comes out to beat down Heyman some more with a kendo stick.

Randy Orton/John Cena/Triple H/Stephanie/Daniel Bryan Interview/Segment- All the Champions on the current roster and a few from the past are standing in the ring to hype the Title match of Sunday. The crowd is going bonkers for Daniel Bryan so much, that Triple H couldn't even finish his interview. After some back and forth from Orton and Cena, CM Punk gets involved when he hits Triple H, which drew a superkick from Shawn Michaels to defend Triple H. Good ending segment to help sell the PPV.
Triple H/Stephanie/John Cena/Randy Orton/Daniel Bryan Interview

Triple H/Stephanie/Randy Orton Interview- What is it with these Christmas shows, that they feel that they need to make them as cheesy as possible. Storylines never develope so you can realistically miss about 2 weeks of WWE TV around this time and not miss anything.

Batista Promo- Batista is making his return. Do I care? If Batista comes back as a heel, then YES! if he comes back as a face, then i'll care for about 2 weeks before he is lost in the mix and then I'll forget that he was ever gone.
Triple H/Paul Heyman/Brock Lesnar Interview- Lesnar is back and challenges anybody in the back to step up. Mark Henry comes out to brawl with Lesnar but is on the wrong side of this brawl.
